description: Tick trades by UTC date. Retrieve available trades for a stock, fund, currency, or futures symbol; other symbol types return 400 `unsupported_symbol_type`. Today's and tomorrow's UTC dates return a rolling snapshot, with 24 hours by default; the previous six dates return their UTC calendar days. U.S.-listed stocks and funds, SIP: codes included, use New York dates instead: today's or tomorrow's date returns the session in progress or, when none is running, the latest one, unless `window` is set. For continuous futures, 1! uses today's front contract and 2! uses today's next contract for every requested date. The response code identifies the selected dated contract. To fetch a day in parts, request `from=2026-09-30T00:00:00Z&to=2026-09-30T12:00:00Z`, then `from=2026-09-30T12:00:00Z`. → Returns {code, bar_type: '1T', last_update?, as_of?, window_start?, series: [{time, us?, close, type?, volume?, trade_id?, trade_exchange?, tape?, trade_conditions?}], error?, message?}. Point time is Unix seconds; us is Unix microseconds; last_update, as_of, and window_start are Unix milliseconds. U.S.-listed stocks and funds, SIP: codes included, take New York dates; other symbols take UTC dates. For today or tomorrow's date, window selects 3h/6h/9h/12h/15h/18h/21h/24h; without it, U.S.-listed stocks and funds return the session in progress or, when none is running, the latest one, and other symbols the last 24 hours. Historical dates ignore window. Rolling snapshots include inclusive window_start and exclusive as_of. Empty results return series: [] with an error and message. Use filter to summarize trades or store=json with output_file to save the response.

date.description: UTC date in YYYY-MM-DD format; U.S.-listed stocks and funds, SIP: codes included, use New York dates. Today and the previous six dates are supported; until midnight, tomorrow's date returns the same data as today's.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

from.description: Return trades at or after this UTC time in ISO 8601 format, within the requested date, or within the window for today's date.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

symbol.description: Symbol in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL, NYSE:TSLA, SIP:AAPL). You can search for this symbol code using the /v3/symbols/search endpoint.

to.description: Return trades before this UTC time in ISO 8601 format, within the requested date, or within the window for today's date.

window.description: Rolling duration for today's or tomorrow's date. Without it, U.S.-listed stocks and funds, SIP: codes included, return the session in progress or the latest one; other symbols use 24 hours. Ignored for historical dates.

name: get_symbol_trades
